assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate these recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness with the underlying supraventricular tachycardia
in this patient with atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
the required precertification (denial CO-197) is requested to support this medical necessity
